author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: International law enforcement disrupts Gootloader, seizing domains and taking down over 100 servers linked to 25,000 infected computers. title: Gootloader Malware Disrupted After Infecting 25,000 Computers

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Unpatched Check Point gateways were hacked worldwide, leading to root access, backdoors, network intrusion and destructive wiper attacks. Starting on 30 October, an attacker scanned and exploited Check Point Security Gateways that hadn’t been patched, going in through the Mobile Access portal. Check Point Research describes the activity as PHP2Shell for initial access, followed by […]
title: Unpatched Check Point Gateways Are Being Wiped exploiting PHP2Shell

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: SignDrop is a Windows zero-day that abuses CLFS security protections to let local attackers gain SYSTEM privileges and bypass defenses. The researcher Chaotic Eclipse, also known as INFINITE NIGHTMARE, MSNightmare, Nightmare-Eclipse, and MSNightmare, published a proof-of-concept for a new Windows local privilege escalation zero-day, naming it SignDrop. title: New SignDrop Exploit Can Abuse Windows Defender to Bypass Security Protections
